fix(transport): answer off-lock frames in order

Dispatch the frames that bypass the session's lock one answer at a time
per socket, in the order their frames arrived: list_sessions answered
concurrently with the ping sent behind it put pong on the wire first,
and the acceptance suite reads session_list before that pong. A turn
still dispatches at once — the lock, not this chain, orders turns, so a
ping is not held behind a run.

Also clears the two lint findings CI named on the last push: the private
summary mapper now sits below its caller in sender.ts, and stopEngines
asks the server for its wss instead of reaching three hops through it.

Documents session_list as §5.9 of the protocol spec with the answer
order pinned, and repoints the anchors the new tests moved.

Refs #144

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
